ns2:course.label: Intermediate Spanish
ns2:course.description: Continued development of reading, writing and conversational skills. Followed by SPAN 141 or SPAN 142, this course fulfills the Liberal Arts and Sciences foreign language requirement. Credit is not given for both SPAN 103 and SPAN 125. Prerequisite: SPAN 102 or SPAN 122, or equivalent placement score.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Credit is not given for both SPAN 103 and SPAN 125. Prerequisite: SPAN 102 or SPAN 122, or equivalent placement score.
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: Class meetings constitute half of the credit hour requirement, the other half is met by on-line, web-based work. Spanish native speakers should enroll in SPAN 125.
